name: Jang Kuk Chol

attribution.legal_posture: Designated under E.O. 13694, as further amended, and E.O. 13810; North Korean banker; Treasury reported that he and Ho Jong Son helped manage funds, including a collective $5.3 million in cryptocurrency, on behalf of First Credit Bank; this is an administrative sanctions designation, with the record carrying no criminal charge or conviction.

caveats: Administrative designation and Treasury-reported collective conduct; no criminal charge or adjudicated finding. The $5.3 million cryptocurrency aggregate and downstream ransomware/IT-worker-revenue linkage apply jointly to Jang Kuk Chol and Ho Jong Son; they are not allocated to Jang individually. First Credit Bank is a reported on-behalf-of relationship; employment, office and personal ownership of the bank's accounts or wallets are unestablished. Vladivostok, Russia is designation-era exact-entry context; residence, continued presence and present location are unestablished. The record retains no account, wallet, address, transaction, victim, counterparty, passport, birth, nationality, gender, contact, precise address or other sensitive selector.
Administrative sanctions listing; the record carries no criminal conviction.
The source supplies its recorded transliterations; an alias transfers to a same-name person or entity only when the source explicitly links it.

Exact-ID merge only: each retained value is explicitly attached by the cited official dataset to the same sanctions-list entry; values stay attached to that entry pending a source bridge to any same-name subject.

identity_boundary: Jang Kuk Chol, listed by OFAC as JANG, Kuk Chol with alternate romanization CHANG, Kuk Ch'o'l, is one of the two North Korean bankers described in Treasury's November 2025 sanctions action. Preserve the collective scope of funds reportedly managed with Ho Jong Son on behalf of First Credit Bank, administrative-designation posture and historical source context. Criminal guilt, present location and ownership of the bank's wallets or a same-named account require separate evidence.
